pairs.subject: measurement-honesty
pairs.evidence: crates/apps/mpsv-vpm/src/lib.rs:2641 The vacancy lifecycle metric is named time_to_close rather than time_to_fill to honestly reflect the observable endpoints of the feed.

techniques.evidence: crates/apps/valuation-multiples/src/lib.rs:287 SDE valuation multiples published together enforce monotonicity low <= median <= high and reject inverted bands before ingestion.

crates/apps/mpsv-vpm/src/lib.rs:2073 When nowcast projection ratio or projected median fails admission checks, the cell's nowcast_median is published as null with the reason in withheld rather than dropping the row or synthesizing an uncalibrated estimate.

crates/apps/smlouvy-dump-watch/src/lib.rs:167 Dump watch uses completeness::judge with a suppress_only disposition, downgrading partial parses to suppress removals rather than tombstoning unparsed dump records.

crates/apps/state-licensing/src/lib.rs:425 When metered calls omit pricing, cost_usd is reported alongside cost_unreported_calls so partial spend totals are explicitly disclosed as a lower-bound floor.
crates/apps/mpsv-vpm/src/lib.rs:359 Aggregated metrics enforce a minCount sample floor (default 3) before publication, suppressing thin cells from publication.

crates/apps/mpsv-vpm/src/lib.rs:2898 Salary percentiles in Cell aggregates are computed over observed non-zero salaries only, and both total postings count and salaryCount are co-published to avoid imputing missing salaries as zero.
crates/apps/mpsv-vpm/src/lib.rs:2641 The posting duration metric is named time_to_close rather than time_to_fill because disappearance from the feed conflates filled, withdrawn, and expired postings.
crates/apps/homewyse-pricing/src/lib.rs:388 Missing or unmeasured price units map to explicit JSON Null rather than coercing to a default string or zero value.
